faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Goa Student Activity & Sports Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the NIT Goa Student Activity & Sports Officer position is 21 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in physical education or sports sciences with at least 60% marks, along with a good academic record and representation in inter-university or state/national competitions. Qualifying UGC's national-level test is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Student Activity & Sports Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Student Activity & Sports Officer position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contractual role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Student Activity & Sports Officer position ranges from Rs. 40,000/- per month for Master's degree holders to Rs. 50,000/- per month for Ph.D. holders.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the NIT Goa recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Student Activity & Sports Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Student Activity & Sports Officer post at the National Institute of Technology Goa.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the NIT Goa Student Activity & Sports Officer recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official NIT Goa website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Student Activity & Sports Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Student Activity & Sports Officer position will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the National Institute of Technology Goa for the Student Activity & Sports Officer position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. You can also visit the official NIT Goa website for more details.
